part3_reconciliation_with_authorization.slack_explanation: the 1-request slack exists because ordinal 1 consumed only 1 of its 2 originally-planned requests (its MIGRATION_TX failed before FUNDING_TX could ever be attempted) -- the nominal remaining authorization (49) was computed simply as 50-1, without yet accounting for the fact that ordinal 1's now-unreachable FUNDING_TX stage further reduces genuine demand. part3_reconciliation_with_authorization.verdict: REAL_FROZEN_PLAN_FITS_WITHIN_NOMINAL_49_REMAINDER -- with 1 request of margin never to be used

part4_58_request_mock_explanation.exact_reason: the B2Z-P2R mocked test (test_19_member_calibration_walk_never_exceeds_original_authorization in tests/test_b2z_p2r_execution_exclusion.py) intentionally used a GENERIC FakeTransport fixture with no no_candidate_mints and, critically, WITHOUT calling seed_frozen_creator_history_from_local_prediction() for any of the 19 members -- so every one of them required the full 3-stage path (MIGRATION_TX + CREATOR_HISTORY + FUNDING_TX = 3 requests each), giving 19*3=57 plus ordinal 1's already-consumed 1 = 58. It did not apply the REAL frozen Stage-2 seed/skip plan (9 of the 19 remaining members -- ordinals 2,4,7,10,12,13,14,17,20 -- are seeded and require only 2 stages each, not 3).
part4_58_request_mock_explanation.test_still_valuable: yes -- it proves the hard physical-request budget guard in DurableB2ZClient.dispatch() fails closed correctly under a worst-case load that WOULD occur if seeding were somehow bypassed or unavailable. It is a defense-in-depth test, not a prediction of real consumption. It was never intended to model the real frozen plan and this reconciliation does not treat it as having done so.

part5_stage2_seeding_verification.note_on_ordinal_1: ordinal 1 WAS in the original Stage-2 seed set (its CREATOR_HISTORY was always planned to be seeded, not dispatched live) -- but ordinal 1 never reached the CREATOR_HISTORY stage at all, because its MIGRATION_TX failed first. So ordinal 1's seed slot is moot; it is excluded from calibration and its planned FUNDING_TX (which would have used the frozen signature) will never be dispatched.

part7_no_candidate_semantics.reminder: 48 is a MAXIMUM, not a forecast.
